description: Central Province - Announcing that Mr. Eric Prasanna Weerawardhana is appointed as the Chairman (Member) of the Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority w.e.f. 24.12.2015
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mr. Eric Prasanna Weerawardhana) and appoints him to a specific post (Chairman/Member of the Central Province Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority). The content also details the specific powers and legal authority (Statute No. 01 of 2000, statements No. 06(a), 6(e) and 7(a)) under which the appointment is made, which constitutes detailed responsibilities and the legal framework for the role. This combination of a named person and detailed description of the appointment's authority qualifies it as a Hybrid gazette (Type 3).
